name: Set a Screen
idea: Stand still like a wall so your teammate’s defender bumps into you.
why: A defender can’t run through a teammate. The screen slows them down and gives your teammate a step of open space.
tryit: When you set a screen, stand still with your feet wide and arms in. No pushing or moving, or it’s a foul!

frames.say: {2} is stuck down low with {X2} right next to them. Let’s help {2} get free!
{3} runs over and stands still next to {X2}, like a wall. That wall is called a *screen*.
{2} races around the screen. {X2} bumps into {3} and gets stuck!
{1} passes to {2}, who is wide open.
Swish! A good screen helps your teammate get open.
